name: Nithin John George
title: Nithin John George · Platform Engineering & SRE
description: Platform engineer working on Kubernetes, GitOps, cloud infrastructure, observability and security. Blog posts and engineering handbooks.
tagline: Platform Engineering · SRE · Cloud Infrastructure · Developer Experience
intro: I build and operate cloud platforms that help engineering teams deliver software safely and independently. 6+ years across GCP, AWS and Kubernetes, with a focus on progressive delivery, infrastructure automation, observability and security.

highlights.title: In-house code security platform
highlights.text: Built and own a platform covering SAST, SBOM/SCA, secret scanning and container scanning on a Python and Temporal backend, with a Backstage developer portal. It replaced a commercial SaaS tool and saves ₹50L+ per year.

highlights.title: Progressive delivery
highlights.text: Scalable CI on GitHub Actions, GitOps with ArgoCD, and canary releases with Argo Rollouts that roll back automatically on latency and error-rate metrics.

highlights.title: Standardised Helm charts
highlights.text: Reusable umbrella Helm charts that now power 150+ microservices.

highlights.title: Cloud migration and foundation
highlights.text: A major role in the AWS to GCP migration, which cut costs and modernised the infrastructure, including the GCP landing zone it was built on.

highlights.title: Self-serve infrastructure
highlights.text: Modernised IaC pipelines so developers can create infrastructure with minimal dependency on the cloud infra team, reducing BAU overhead.

highlights.title: Dynamic staging environments
highlights.text: In-house staging environments on Kubernetes using ArgoCD and gateway header routing.

highlights.title: Observability backbone
highlights.text: Self-hosted the telemetry stack on LGTM and unified it into a single platform.

highlights.title: AI-powered DevOps assistant
highlights.text: An assistant that simplifies Terraform debugging through error analysis and automated problem resolution. Won a company-wide hackathon.

highlights.title: Self-hosted GitHub runners
highlights.text: Actions runners on Kubernetes, which cut workflow cost and queue time.

headline: Platform Engineer · SRE · Cloud Infrastructure
motd: I build and operate cloud platforms that help engineering teams deliver software safely and independently. With 6+ years of experience across GCP, AWS and Kubernetes, I focus on Platform Engineering, Progressive Delivery, Infrastructure Automation, Observability and Developer Experience.
heroLine: SDE 3 on Porter's Engineering Platform team. I build the delivery, infrastructure and security platform that application teams ship on.
